<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：オビ＝ワンの住居</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">オビ＝ワンを配備する場合、配備コスト－３。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを占領していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-134o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut.

'''Light Side:''' When deploying Obi-Wan, deployment cost is −3.

'''Dark Side:''' If you occupy here, add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Dark uses occupy; English uses control.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
